info.title: Playground API
info.description: Zero-config per-identity sandboxed mock REST API with relational filtering, dynamic sorting, and network simulation.

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of users. Results merge shared global user records with session sandbox overlays (newly created users appear at the top).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query term across name, username, email, etc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-indexed, default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page (default 10, max 200).

parameters.name: _sort
parameters.description: Field name to sort results by (e.g. name, id, username, email).

parameters.name: _order
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc (default) or desc.

post.summary: Create a new session sandbox user record. Returns a local-<uuid> formatted ID with _sandbox: 'created'. Each session identity is capped at 30 created records.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Full name of the user.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number.

parameters.name: website
parameters.description: Website URL.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: JSON object containing street, city, zipcode.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: JSON object containing company name and catchPhrase.

get.summary: Retrieve a single user by ID. Supports plain integer IDs for global records (e.g. 1) and string IDs formatted as local-<uuid> for session sandbox records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID (e.g. 1 for global user or local-<uuid> for sandbox user).

put.summary: Replace an existing user record in the session overlay. Global records remain untouched for other visitors and preserve original list position.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID to update (e.g. 1 or local-<uuid>).

patch.summary: Partially update specific fields of a user record in the session overlay.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID to patch (e.g. 1 or local-<uuid>).

delete.summary: Remove a user record from the requesting session view. The underlying global record is unaffected for other visitors.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID to delete (e.g. 1 or local-<uuid>).

example.message: Resource 'users' with id '1' deleted successfully from sandbox overlay

post.summary: Authenticate user with username/email & password to receive signed JWT access and refresh tokens.
Register a new session user and immediately receive signed JWT tokens.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a fresh 15-minute JWT access token.

get.summary: Retrieve current authenticated user profile using Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.

patch.summary: Update current authenticated user profile in the session sandbox using Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
